# USA Economics Olympiad (USAEO)

> USAEO is a free 501(c)(3) nonprofit running a national economics competition for high school students. Open to all U.S. high school students - no school sponsorship or teacher nomination required.

USAEO operates a Quiz Bowl, Essay competition, National Qualifiers, and National Finals. We also publish a free open economics curriculum, host workshops, and run school chapters across the country.

## Contact

- Website: https://usaeo.org
- Email: info@usaeo.org

## Core pages

- [Home](https://usaeo.org/): Overview of USAEO programs.
- [About](https://usaeo.org/about): Mission, history, nonprofit status.
- [Competitions](https://usaeo.org/competitions): All USAEO competition tracks.
- [Quiz Bowl](https://usaeo.org/competitions/quiz-bowl): Team-based economics quiz competition.
- [Essay](https://usaeo.org/competitions/essay): Individual economics essay competition.
- [National Qualifiers](https://usaeo.org/competitions/qualifiers): Online qualifying round.
- [National Finals](https://usaeo.org/competitions/finals): In-person final round.
- [Partner Competitions](https://usaeo.org/competitions/partner-competitions): Affiliated competitions.
- [Partner Programs](https://usaeo.org/partner-programs): Affiliated economics programs.

## Resources

- [Curriculum](https://usaeo.org/curriculum): Free six-unit open economics curriculum.
- [Workshops](https://usaeo.org/workshops): Free workshops for students.
- [Research](https://usaeo.org/research): Student research opportunities.
- [News](https://usaeo.org/news): Announcements and articles.

## Community

- [Chapters](https://usaeo.org/chapters): Local USAEO school chapters.

- [Careers / Apply](https://usaeo.org/careers/apply): Volunteer and team applications.
